items.rationale: Covered under 2.4.3(a) as frost-related fracture damage to internal pipework/fittings; indemnity per 7.1.9 for like-for-like replacement, capped at ordinary market price.
Replacement of connection hose is covered as part of the frost-burst fitting repair under 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.9, as it is a necessary connection element renewed with the fitting.
Labour for repair of affected internal fitting is covered under 7.1.9 and 7.1.7; 3 hours is reasonable for diagnosis, removal, and replacement.
Consumables used in the covered repair are indemnified under 7.1.7(e) and 7.1.9, provided they are not general admin/overhead.
One attendance per trade is indemnified if covered work was performed (7.1.11); reference cases show vehicle costs for similar work are not indemnified above 6 EUR, often 0.
Leak location (including imaging equipment) is covered under 2.4.5 and 5.2.2, capped at EUR 2,500 per event; reference case 7 supports full indemnity for this line.
External surface damage from frost is excluded under 3.5(a) and (b); policy explicitly excludes repair of external surfaces for frost, moisture, or weathering.
Removal and renewal of external plaster due to frost is excluded under 3.5(a)-(c); not indemnified even if invoiced with covered work.
Renewal of base plaster on external surface due to frost is excluded under 3.5(a)-(c); not indemnified.
Any additional work on external surfaces due to frost is excluded under 3.5; not indemnified.
Renewal of substrate/plaster on external surface due to frost is excluded under 3.5(a)-(c); not indemnified.
Recoating of external surface due to frost is excluded under 3.5(b)-(d); not indemnified.
Drying of external surfaces due to frost is excluded under 3.5(b)-(c); not indemnified.
Priming of external surfaces due to frost is excluded under 3.5(b)-(c); not indemnified.
Labour for external surface repair due to frost is excluded under 3.5(b)-(c); not indemnified.
Flat rate for external surface repair due to frost is excluded under 3.5(c); not indemnified.
